limitations: Instrument-only static mock fixture. It establishes no task, model, training, evaluation, scorer, runtime, or efficacy claim.
No hidden score is read by selection; MockScoreReceipt is caller-supplied synthetic metadata.
ArtifactLock is an immutable Python record, not tamper-proof storage. LockRegistry is in-memory, process-local, non-durable, and does not provide remote or cross-process at-most-once publication.

File checks reject lexical outside-root paths and observable symlinks, then hash bytes read at verification. They are not a race-free filesystem sandbox and do not defend against concurrent replacement, hard links, hostile local filesystem access, or root-parent symlink semantics.
No on-disk lock publication is implemented, so this slice makes no atomic filesystem publication or no-replace claim.
No B/C/G policy, trusted enforcement, native ARGO integration, external dependency, subprocess, network, ORX, or real experiment execution is included.
